# Checkpoint

Task: Fix scalar string to []string configuration decoding so whitespace-separated values, including CORS allowed origins and ENV sources, produce ordered slices. Preserve non-string and sequence values.

Status: Complete.

Changes:
- Replaced comma split hook with a string-to-[]string hook using strings.Fields.
- Enabled explicitly empty ENV values so they decode as empty slices.
- Updated advanced YAML fixture and added regression coverage for YAML, ENV, empty input, mixed whitespace, sequences, and non-string hook input.

Verification: `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./internal/config -count=1` passed; `git diff --check` passed.

+func stringToStringSliceHook(from, to reflect.Type, data interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+	if from == nil || from.Kind() != reflect.String || to != reflect.TypeOf([]string{}) {
+		return data, nil
+	}
+
+	return strings.Fields(reflect.ValueOf(data).String()), nil
+}

+func TestAllowedOriginsScalar(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name  string
+		value string
+		want  []string
+	}{
+		{
+			name:  "mixed whitespace",
+			value: " \tfoo.com\t\tbar.com\n\n baz.com  \t",
+			want:  []string{"foo.com", "bar.com", "baz.com"},
+		},
+		{
+			name:  "empty",
+			value: "",
+			want:  []string{},
+		},
+		{
+			name:  "whitespace only",
+			value: " \t\n  ",
+			want:  []string{},
+		},
+		{
+			name:  "comma is not whitespace",
+			value: "foo.com,bar.com",
+			want:  []string{"foo.com,bar.com"},
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+			content := fmt.Sprintf("cors:\n  allowed_origins: %q\n", tt.value)
+			require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(content), 0600))
+
+			cfg, err := Load(path)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.want, cfg.Cors.AllowedOrigins)
+
+			t.Setenv("FLIPT_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS", tt.value)
+			fromEnv, err := Load("./testdata/default.yml")
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.want, fromEnv.Cors.AllowedOrigins)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestAllowedOriginsSequence(t *testing.T) {
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("cors:\n  allowed_origins: [\"foo.com bar.com\", baz.com]\n"), 0600))
+
+	cfg, err := Load(path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, []string{"foo.com bar.com", "baz.com"}, cfg.Cors.AllowedOrigins)
+}
+
+func TestStringToStringSliceHookOtherTypes(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, data := range []interface{}{
+		[]string{"foo.com", "bar.com"},
+		[]interface{}{"foo.com", "bar.com"},
+		42,
+		nil,
+	} {
+		got, err := stringToStringSliceHook(reflect.TypeOf(data), reflect.TypeOf([]string{}), data)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		assert.Equal(t, data, got)
+	}
+
+	data := "foo.com bar.com"
+	got, err := stringToStringSliceHook(reflect.TypeOf(data), reflect.TypeOf([]int{}), data)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, data, got)
+}
